ResearchProjectDef.label: seed saving
ResearchProjectDef.description: Collect seed from your best plants and keep it. Unlocks the "collect seeds" order, seed stock for growing zones and planters, seed saving at harvest, and lets your growers describe how plants differ.

ResearchProjectDef.label: plant breeding
ResearchProjectDef.description: Controlled pollination. Build a crossing bench to cross two strains or self-pollinate one, see several offspring and keep the best. Your botanists now measure traits exactly and record lineage.

ResearchProjectDef.label: propagation
ResearchProjectDef.description: Grow exact copies of a plant from cuttings. Build a propagation bench to multiply a strain's seed true to type, which hybrids can't do by themselves.

ResearchProjectDef.label: genetic analysis
ResearchProjectDef.description: Read a plant's full genotype, including hidden recessive alleles and carried genes. Unlocks the genetic analyzer (also a facility that shows offspring genotypes at the crossing bench), the gene bank that archives strains, and culture medium.

ResearchProjectDef.label: tissue culture
ResearchProjectDef.description: Micropropagation in sterile culture. The tissue culture lab turns one seed packet into twelve identical ones.

ResearchProjectDef.label: mutagenesis
ResearchProjectDef.description: Induce mutations with radiation and chemicals. The mutagen chamber produces several mutants of a strain (up to level +6, sometimes new industrial genes) and can double chromosome sets with colchicine (polyploid: +6 genome capacity).

ResearchProjectDef.label: gene splicing
ResearchProjectDef.description: Precise genome editing. The gene splicer sets any locus to an allele level in your allele library (up to +8) and splices known genes into any species. Gene reagent is made at the fabrication bench.

ResearchProjectDef.label: seed synthesis
ResearchProjectDef.description: Print seed from an archived genome without any parent seed. The seed synthesizer works on its own and can keep a chosen stock topped up.

ResearchProjectDef.label: synthetic traits
ResearchProjectDef.description: Designed genes that never evolved: circadian override (grows around the clock), gene compression (+6 capacity), runners (fields refill themselves) and, with Biotech, toxin scrubbers. Spliced at the gene splicer.

ResearchProjectDef.label: genome synthesis
ResearchProjectDef.description: Write plant genomes from scratch. The genesis synthesizer reaches allele levels +9 and +10 with no library, installs synthetic chromosomes (+12 capacity) and splices ultratech genes: chemosynthesis and deathless tissue. Runs on archogenetic catalyst.

ResearchProjectDef.label: phytomining
ResearchProjectDef.description: Plants that pull metals out of the ground: ferrophyte (steel), argentophyte (silver) and aurophyte (gold) genes for the genesis synthesizer.
